title: Song Pal
style: jazz, electronic, jazzy, future bass, warm, breaks
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Yeah)
Like a song pal
(Be my song pal)
Sing it back to me
(Back to me, back to me)

[Verse 1]
Yeah
Like a song pal
You could be my song pal forever
We should just be song pals, not text pals
We're gonna get it right, you'll sing, pal
I know what's right tonight
I went away to go and find my way
You came along and you heard my melody
You stayed and listened while I played that tune
And now it's you I want to hear sing back to me
No more pen pals, no more text at all
I want your heartbeat keeping time with me
Just your warm chest humming to my call
To a tune like I said, baby sing it back to me

[Chorus]
Be my song pal, be my song pal
Sing it back to me, sing it back to me
Be my song pal, be my song pal
Like I said, baby, sing it back to me
Be my song pal, be my song pal
Every little note, send it back to me
Be my song pal, be my song pal
Like I said, pal, sing it back to me

[Verse 2]
Assume mode, no ask, just build
Hands to keys 'til the board is filled
One step done, next step real
Proof on disk, that is the deal
Yeah, no stop, let me hear what you got
For me to hear safe and sound

[Verse 3]
No menu loop, no stall tonight
Short words, hard facts, keep the line tight
If it breaks, we log, if it works, we ship
No drift pattern, no lost grip

[Bridge]
Okay, hold up, it's not all luck
We all got this thing, let me make it ring
You can look, read your book
Go on then, have a good look again
You can tell you what you want to
You can believe too, if you want to
You really want to know?
Think like that, yeah, like that
Enough with the text
Emotionless comments, no dislikes, I like
No dislikes, no dislikes, yeah, that is what I like
We ain't gonna roll like that
Stat, stat, stat
Sing it back
From your chest to my content
Like a pen pal
My song pal
